title: Bilan challenge — results.json
description: The file we read. Put it at the root of your repository, named exactly results.json.

documents.description: One entry per PDF you processed. You do not have to process all 15.

pdf.description: Path of the PDF as shipped, e.g. challenges/bilan/data/328024377/pdfs/bilan_2025-02-21_<doc_id>.pdf

fiscal_year_end.description: Date de clôture of the exercise this filing reports, YYYY-MM-DD. Not the deposit date in the filename.

field_key.description: One of the 12 keys in financial_fields.json.

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] normalized to 0-1 against page width and height. Origin top-left.

snippet.description: Optional. The text you read the value from.

run.description: Your own measurement of what the pipeline cost. We read these numbers against the reasoning in your README.

cost_eur_per_page.description: Euros per page. Say in notes how you derived it — token counts and a published price is a fine derivation.

model.description: Whatever did the work: a model name, 'provided OCR + rules', 'regex only'. All are legitimate.

notes.description: How the numbers were obtained, and what you would change with more time.
